## Progress Update — WhatsApp Message Scheduler Bot Plan

- **Milestone 1 Gating & Iteration 2 Remediation**: In response to challenger findings, the orchestrator gated Milestone 1 and dispatched Worker M1 Gen 2 to address all 7 identified engineering edge cases.
- **Comprehensive Document Expansion**: `docs/FEASIBILITY_AND_PLATFORM_ARCHITECTURE.md` has expanded to ~1,340 lines (86 KB) with hardened production-grade specifications and concrete code snippets.
- **Adversarial Issues Directly Resolved**:
  - Replaced the clamped Gaussian typing delay with a multi-modal human typing model (burst typing, inter-word cognitive pauses, and message-length-proportional bounds).
  - Hardened the Baileys disconnection state machine with exponential backoff and circuit-breaker limits on error 515 (`restartRequired`) to eliminate unthrottled reconnect recursion.
  - Optimized the PostgreSQL session adapter with batched Signal key upserts (`INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE`) to eliminate N+1 database roundtrips.
  - Added token-bucket rate limiting algorithms for the Cloud API and a granular unit-economic crossover analysis comparing API fees against infrastructure costs.
- **Next Steps**: Worker M1 Gen 2 is completing handoff generation, after which the orchestrator will trigger re-verification to clear the Milestone 1 gate and transition into Milestone 2 (Scheduling Engine & System Design).
